reply.text:
For most beginners, about 2 to 3 sets per exercise is plenty. A good starting point is 3 sets of 8 to 12 reps with a weight that leaves you 2 to 3 reps in the tank. Across a week, that usually works out to something like 8 to 12 hard sets per muscle group, spread over two or three sessions.

Start there and add a set or a little weight only once the work feels easy and your form holds up. If you'd like, I can build you a session or a block so the app sets the numbers for you.
